question.prompt: The points \(A(-3,y_1)\), \(B(1,y_2)\), and \(C(2,y_3)\) all lie on the parabola \(y=-x^2\). What is the order of \(y_1\), \(y_2\), and \(y_3\)?

solutions.explanation: Substituting each value gives \(y_1=-9\), \(y_2=-1\), and \(y_3=-4\), so \(y_2>y_3>y_1\). This can also be determined from the fact that the parabola opens downward and the function value decreases as the distance from the axis of symmetry increases.
solutions.title: Evaluate and compare, with a symmetry observation
